origin.description: Run code with environment variables set, then restore them.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: Mapping of names to values. None unsets.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while the variables are set.

origin.details: An unset variable is an empty string from Sys.getenv and an empty string here after the call. None in the mapping unsets a variable.

translation.description: Run code with environment variables set, then restore them.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: Mapping of names to values. None unsets.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while the variables are set.

translation.details: An unset variable is an empty string from Sys.getenv and an empty string here after the call. None in the mapping unsets a variable. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

inside = with_envvar({"WITHR_TEST_VAR": "secret"}, lambda: os.environ.get("WITHR_TEST_VAR"))
after = os.environ.get("WITHR_TEST_VAR", "")
return [inside, after]
